Welcome to Line to Riches 💸!

⏳ Wait in line to go up on the stand!
💰 Donate Robux to players on the stand to get cash
🏃 Skip players in line using cash to get to the stand quicker!
🤑 Get to the stand for everyone to see your products and donate you Robux!

👍 Like and join the group for +1.5x Cash
💻 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile and Tablet players
